summary.dataset_text_note: Per-item `question` and `gold` text from the LOCOMO dataset is not redistributed here. Metrics, token counts, conversation id and category are retained, so every aggregate in `summary` stays auditable; re-run harness/run_locomo_qa.py against your own copy of locomo10.json (github.com/snap-research/locomo) to regenerate the per-item text.

measured_with.retrieval: dense + BM25/RRF + cross-encoder rerank, top_k 15, 10k-char budget
measured_with.note: The reader also acts as judge; a separate judge model would be preferable.
